findings.issue: Existing renderers did not expose the four-digits-per-group structure used by Chinese large-number reading.
findings.revision: Add generic placeValueGroups renderer with dynamic group labels and accessible semantics.

summary: After textbook re-grounding and flow refinement, four-digit grouping, zero-reading rules, fresh independent reading evidence, writing transfer, and the generic placeValueGroups renderer satisfy the ready gate.
